values.note: Electric sites April-September: $35 weeknights, $45 weekends, $55 holidays; October-March $25-30. Plus the $8.75 reservation fee and a daily entrance permit ($10 a vehicle, $20 with a trailered boat).

Carter Lake: 'Electric campsite (April – September) $35 / $45 / $55'; '(October – March) $25 / $30'; 'Reservation fee: $8.75 per site, per camping trip') + https://www.larimercamping.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=LARC&parkId=710102 ('Daily Permits: $10/day per vehicle or trailered watercraft. $20/day for vehicle + trailered watercraft.'; 'Campsite Reservation Fee: $8.75'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 47 50-amp electric sites (E02-E49 without E34), 43 of them pull-through, listed for vehicles 32-80 ft (most 40-50). E01-E22 sit on a hill overlooking the lake; E23-E49 are in a meadow below the dam with no lake view.

sites.source: https://www.larimercamping.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=LARC&parkId=710102 (site list, loop 'Eagle Campground': 47 rows 'STANDARD ELECTRIC', 'Equip length/ Driveway' 32-80 with Pull-Through 43 / Back-In 4) + site E02 page ('Sites E23–E49 are not near the water, they are in a meadow below the dam with no view of the lake. Sites E01-E22 are on a hill overlooking the lake.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Token-operated shower house with flush toilets next to the overflow lot; vault toilets around the loop. Water spigots are shut off September-April except the frost-free ones.

facilities.source: https://www.larimercamping.com/camping/carter-lake/r/campsiteDetails.do?contractCode=LARC&siteId=425&parkId=710102 ('Shower House: Located next to the overflow parking lot, is token operated, and has standard flushing toilets. Additional vault toilets are located throughout the campground.'; 'Water spigots (with hookups) are located in each campground except for Carter Knolls ... Water is available at frost-free spigots year round. All other spigots are turned off from September–April (tentative).'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.larimercamping.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=LARC&parkId=710102 ('Status: Open year round.'; 'It is open year round.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: A reservation and a park entrance permit are required before setting up at any site; a no-show unannounced within 24 hours may lose the site (call 970-619-4570). Check-in noon, check-out 11 am. One wheeled camping unit per site.

booking.source: https://www.larimercamping.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=LARC&parkId=710102 ('Campers MUST make a reservation and purchase a park entrance permit BEFORE setting up at any campsite.'; 'One Camping Unit Per Site'; 'No Shows: ...') + site E02 page (Checkin 12:00 pm, Checkout 11:00 am), read 2026-10-28

note: Larimer County campground at the north end of Carter Lake, west of Loveland; the loop runs from a hill above the lake (E01-E22, with lake views) down into a meadow below the dam (E23-E49, no view). --Claude
summary: Larimer County booking site (park page, full site list, five Eagle site pages) + county permits page: confirmed electric 50 (no water/sewer), $35/$45 + $8.75, year-round, showers, reservable.
